blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has formally turned over the chairmanship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, marking a new leadership for the regional intergovernmental organization in 2027. During the closing ceremony of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits on Tuesday night, Marcos handed Wong a gavel for a ceremonial turnover of the Asean leadership, marking the end of the Philippines’ chairmanship that spanned a huge part of 2026.
